scientific_integrity: Original theorem is an exact mathematical statement for the explicitly defined iid exponential precipitation and mass-conserving single-store routing process. Deterministic equations proved analytically; supplementary rational and floating-point checks do not substitute for proof. No field calibration, robustness or independent audit is asserted.
scientific_limitations: A fixed annual infiltration cap and single linear carry-over store
Population rather than empirical sample correlations
Other rainfall laws, varying cap, additional stores and finite-sample uncertainty are outside scope
Published antecedent coverage can be incomplete
title: Sharp memory overshoot from thresholded rainfall routing into a linear store
